newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish central bank bought Skr for mark - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Swedish central bank bought Skr for mark - dealers.

text.p: The Swedish central bank, the Riksbank, bought crowns for mark on Wednesday, dealers said.
"The Riksbank has been in buying crowns but it seems it has not had enough muscle," one dealer said.
Dealers said behind the intervention was not the intention to defend a certain level but to dampen the volatility.
At 1315 GMT the crown traded at 4.4690 against the mark compared to 4.4505 late on Tuesday.

It weakened on a Financial Times article that Italy would be offered a deal that would delay its entry into Europe's Economic and Monetary Union until 2000 or 2001 to assuage German fears that an initial lira entry would weaken the single currency.
